owner_direction: Use a limited one-time hobby-purpose real-data batch, then use the calibrated ranges inside Synthetic worlds rather than building a bulk historical mirror.
purpose: Obtain a deliberately small, provenance-bearing reality calibration batch sufficient to constrain ranges, semantics, missingness and plausible scenario families for the first narrow Reality-Calibrated world slice, while minimizing copying and avoiding bulk harvesting.

evidence_role.label: BURNED_REALITY_CALIBRATION_BATCH
may_calibrate: plausible line-shape families when a lawful PRE line snapshot is available
broad assumption ranges for later Synthetic sensitivity
may_not_claim: population-exact frequencies from a small convenience sample

collection_design.selection_rule: Choose coverage before reading model outcomes; do not select races because PEER/N1/C1 appears favorable.
coverage_targets_not_statistical_claims: multiple venues rather than one venue only
more than one bank-length class where available
both FI and FII if available in the capture window
multiple race stages/class bands when sourceable
capture all seven active rider PRE rows for each admitted race
capture line snapshot only when source/timestamp/provenance is genuinely PRE-admissible
collection_design.sample_size_rule: Keep the batch intentionally small. Size is determined by minimum coverage of the prespecified dimensions, not by collecting every available race. If a dimension cannot be covered without bulk collection or uncertain rights, leave it uncalibrated and use ASSUMPTION_RANGE later.
collection_design.stop_rule: Stop collection once prespecified coverage is reached. Do not expand because a model result is interesting.

allowed_fields: competition_score at cutoff if captured point-in-time
win/quinella/trio rates at cutoff if captured point-in-time
S/H/B and maneuver summaries at cutoff if captured point-in-time
registration region/affiliation where officially displayed and admissible
weather/wind only with an explicit observation timestamp at or before decision cutoff
PRE_EVENT_EXPECTED_LINE or LEGSHOW_OBSERVED_LINE only with lawful pre-race provenance
prohibited_fields_and_actions: current profile values backfilled into older races
external provider contact without separate Owner approval

storage_minimization.preferred: Store normalized numeric/structural facts plus source URL, retrieval timestamp and payload hash/provenance reference; avoid retaining unnecessary page text/images.
storage_minimization.raw_payload: Retain only if clearly permitted/necessary for provenance under the applicable private-use/research basis; otherwise store hash plus minimal extracted facts.

exact_point_estimates_allowed: official immutable/stable program or venue facts
calibration_after_capture.empirical_small_batch_use: Use robust observed ranges, support sets and coarse sensitivity envelopes rather than asserting population-exact probabilities.
calibration_after_capture.candidate_independence: No C0/C1/N1/PEER performance may alter the calibration ranges after they are frozen.

next_steps: bind exact public source pages and a capture timestamp protocol
capture only the minimum admitted batch
freeze normalized calibration evidence before any Reality truth-generator execution
build Reality truth sensitivity families from the frozen calibration ranges
keep the calibration batch burned and out of later validation
